name: idleboard-isgroi
description: Código-fonte do painel local para PokeIdle.io

scripts.dev: set IDLEBOARD_MODE=development&& set IDLEBOARD_DEV_BACKGROUND_THROTTLING=1&& electron app
scripts.dev:baseline: set IDLEBOARD_MODE=development&& set IDLEBOARD_DEV_BACKGROUND_THROTTLING=0&& electron app
scripts.check: node --check app/main.cjs && node --check app/preload.cjs && node --check app/game-preload.cjs && node --check app/performance-mode.cjs && node --check app/ui/app.js && node --check app/ui/preview.js && node --check scripts/build.cjs && node --check scripts/release.cjs
scripts.release: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/release.cjs
